messages:
Marin (devex): FYI I hit a nasty edge with the onboarding sample app today. Sequence: app POSTs create-user with Idempotency-Key, server returns 429 with Retry-After: 2, Node SDK waits but on retry the user header got lost so we created a duplicate.
Lee (sdk): Oof. Do you have the network trace? Is it dropped by our retry layer or overwritten during token refresh?
Marin (devex): Trace attached in gist but minimal repro below. Note the SDK refreshes short-lived tokens in-flight when expiry hits, and our header map got rebuilt without preserving custom headers.
Marin (devex): repro snippet:
```
# client
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/users \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer shortlive-token" \ 
  -H "Idempotency-Key: onboard-xyz-01" \ 
  -d '{"email":"u@example.com"}'
# server responds 429 + Retry-After: 2
# SDK retries after 2s but Authorization was rotated; Idempotency-Key missing on second request
```
Rina (eng-runtime): Server log shows two inserts: idempotency=onboard-xyz-01 and idempotency=generated-9a4f. That implies the server accepted both as distinct.
Lee (sdk): That matches a bug we discussed: Node SDK used to auto-generate an idempotency key when none present, but it was also generating a new one for retries in streaming and longpoll flows. We should never overwrite a user-supplied Idempotency-Key.
Theo (product): This is especially bad for our first-run UX. Duplicate accounts = immediate churn. Can we standardize behavior across SDKs?
Rina (eng-runtime): Proposal: 1) SDKs MUST preserve caller-supplied Idempotency-Key across all retry attempts, including across token refresh. 2) SDKs MAY attach internal replay metadata header (x-rw-replay-id) for visibility. 3) Clients should respect server Retry-After header; if missing, use full-jitter exponential backoff (min=100ms, cap=10s). 4) Add optional client config safeReplayWindowMs (default 120000). Outside that window a retry with same key is treated as a new logical request and server may create new resource.
Marin (devex): Suggest the sample app include a tiny test harness that flips the token mid-flight to validate header preservation. CI should run that in onboarding integration.
Lee (sdk): Implementation notes: Node change is small: when constructing retry headers, merge originalHeaders into retryHeaders but do not overwrite Idempotency-Key. Also persist customHeaders across token refresh flow. I'll mark this change semver-patch.
Rina (eng-runtime): On the server side we can also be stricter: if Idempotency-Key is present and x-rw-replay-id indicates repeated attempt within safeReplayWindowMs, reject duplicate side effects and return 409 or a 200 with stored result. We already store result mapping for 2 minutes by default, so this fits.
Marin (devex): Tests to add: - unit test that headers survive token rotation - e2e with staging canary where we inject 429+Retry-After - sample app smoke asserting single side effect when same key within window - negative test for outside-window behavior.
Lee (sdk): Also flag for SDK: when user sets strictIdempotency: true, the SDK should fail fast instead of mutating keys or retrying without honoring their header (useful for payment-like flows). We'll add to client options.
Theo (product): Can we log a small guide in onboarding docs: recommended pattern, how to set header, how to read x-rw-replay-id in console traces, and example strictIdempotency usage?
Marin (devex): I'll open a PR to update the sample app and CI tests. ci-bot: running quick canary test now.
ci-bot: Canary integration triggered for sha: ef56ab12.
Rina (eng-runtime): I'll coordinate a small server tweak to ensure server-side replay mapping honors client-supplied keys and extends mapping when we see x-rw-replay-id.
Lee (sdk): I'll land Node patch, then backport to Python/Go. Will include docs and release notes about Retry-After precedence and safeReplayWindowMs.
Marin (devex): Thanks. Please ping here with PR links and I'll update onboarding docs and the quickstart note.
Theo (product): Prioritize as P1 for onboarding reliability sprint.
Marin (devex): :thumbsup:
